report_name: St Helens Borough Local Cycling & Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) outputs were used as part of the demand-based data analysis to inform the network planning process.
other_tools_developed: Cycling Level of Service tool (based on LTN 1/20), Scheme Prioritisation Framework (Effectiveness & Needs Based Appraisal and Deliverability appraisal)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The St Helens Southern Gateway project has secured multimillion pound funding to deliver the Liverpool City Region’s first ‘Cycle Optimised Protected Signals’ (CYCLOPS) junction, and 'pop-up' cycle lanes on Chester Lane and Clock Face Road now carry an average of over 3,100 active trips every week.
